headline: Security fixes and new defaults led the week, and auto mode now asks less in Antigravity CLI and Claude Code.

themes.title: Security fixes in Antigravity CLI
themes.facts: Antigravity CLI [1.5.14](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.14) fixed a Windows credential leak through UNC paths, and [1.5.17](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.17) closes a bypass of approval and deny rules on sensitive files in enterprise sessions.
themes.so_what: update Antigravity CLI to 1.5.17 or later.

themes.title: New defaults change effort and marketplace updates
themes.facts: Antigravity CLI [1.5.15](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.15) defaults Orchestrator effort to high when unset. Claude Code [2.1.331](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.331) auto-updates managed plugin marketplaces from November 30 unless you set `autoUpdate` to false.
themes.so_what: pin the effort and marketplace settings you rely on before the defaults apply to your jobs.

themes.title: Auto mode asks less in more places
themes.facts: Antigravity CLI [1.5.14](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.14) stopped asking before reads outside the workspace, and [1.5.16](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.16) asks less often before creating or editing files inside Git, Jujutsu or Mercurial repositories. Claude Code [2.1.332](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.332) starts terminal and VS Code sessions in auto mode on some clouds.
themes.so_what: fewer prompts also means fewer checkpoints, so keep your ask and deny rules current.

watch_next: Claude Code's managed marketplace auto-update starts on November 30, so review those settings before then. Kilo Code v7.8.40 moved auto-approve to a user-level setting, so check your rules after updating.
